<!-- pr-reviewer: 71a7fee47351ae5e513b4cfbebfbd04868a7ad28 -->

Head reviewed: `71a7fee47` (short). Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge. merge-ready stands.

This is the independent review of the safety-floor lane. The author's own marker does not count here.

**What looks good**

- The stock contract is honest: `StockFloor` speaks only at and above its depth, and `material_at` intersects only the floors that reach the cut depth (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/rest/stock.rs:127`). A depth no floor reaches is refused by name before anything is planned.
- The entry proof is asked twice, of the polygon and of the conservative raster, with a margin (`entry.rs:57`). The stock as given owns the proof; a pass's own clearing is never credited.
- Every feed, lead and link is walked on the never-small raster before it is kept, and an overload refuses the plan with the place (`pass.rs:90`, `pass.rs:158`).
- The three guards each have a mutation test that fails without it (`rest/tests.rs`).
- Budgets stop the planner from spinning or hanging: passes, work, dead runs, phases all capped (`peel.rs:42-56`).
- `rest2d::rest_strategy` still refuses Adaptive by name (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest2d.rs:195`). Nothing posts from this generator yet. No new command, so no MCP tool is owed; the body says so.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests in the new files. Index math clamps (`canon.rs:113`, `conservative.rs:48`). Provenance lines are on all new modules. Changelog and `Fixes` lines are in the body.

**Results (built locally, merged with main at `780b0a25a`; trial merge was clean)**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib` | 392 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test rest_adaptive` | 9 passed, 0 failed (85 s) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 340 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib` | 166 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --lib -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: clippy with `--all-targets`, and the app and sim crates under clippy. The diff touches only the motion crate.

**Notes (not blocking)**

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/raster.rs` is now 404 lines. It was over 400 before. Split it at the next touch.
2. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/rest/canon.rs:135`: `point()` returns (0, 0) for an out-of-range wall index. The index cannot go out of range by construction. A named error there would keep a future bug from cutting at the origin.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Review cost: effort:high (issue #2109). No escalation. Safety-floor PR: independent review posted by this lane in addition to the author's self-marker. Built and tested locally at head 71a7fee47.
